Released: 25 September 2026

This release of EDB Postgres® AI for CloudNativePG™ Cluster includes the following:

## Enhancements

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added <code>spec.postgresql.epas.tde.keyLength</code> (128, the default, or 256) so EPAS
and PG Extended clusters can move to AES-256 Transparent Data Encryption.
</summary><hr/><p>Requires EPAS or PG Extended 16 or newer; the field is immutable after
creation, since changing it would need re-encrypting existing data. Major
upgrades now derive the key length from the old data directory instead of
trusting the spec.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Added `restoreAdditionalCommandArgs` to `.barmanObjectStore.data` for in-tree
Barman Cloud recoveries, so custom flags are forwarded to
`barman-cloud-restore` during recovery.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11278">#11278</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Plugin authors no longer need to re-derive whether an empty WAL archive should
be treated as an error: the operator now computes the
`check_empty_wal_archive` decision once and passes it to CNPG-I plugins on
both WAL archiving and restore hooks.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11216">#11216</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Allowed setting the <code>ssl_ecdh_curve</code> PostgreSQL parameter in
<code>.spec.postgresql.parameters</code>.
</summary><hr/><p>It was previously rejected by the validating webhook even though the operator
does not manage it. Contributed by @Jamstah.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11308">#11308</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added support for setting <code>auth_user</code> in <code>spec.pgbouncer.parameters</code> to
override the user PgBouncer uses for its <code>auth_query</code> connection, instead of
always deriving it from the <code>authQuerySecret</code>.
</summary><hr/><p>Useful with a custom <code>authQuerySecret</code> where the role to authenticate as
differs from the one implied by the Secret. Contributed by @jonasbadstuebner.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/10899">#10899</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed PgBouncer metrics silently reporting zero when PgBouncer adds or
reorders columns: <code>SHOW STATS</code> and <code>SHOW POOLS</code> results are now matched by
column name instead of by position.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @AdzerKI (<code>SHOW STATS</code>).</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11366">#11366</a>, <a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11464">#11464</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Added a `--dry-run` option to the `backup` command that prints the `Backup`
resource that would be created, without creating it.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11233">#11233</a></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Security Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a webhook validation bypass where an absolute extension path with an
embedded <code>..</code> traversal (e.g. <code>/a/../../../../etc</code>) was accepted because only
the raw path was checked; such paths still escaped the extension's mount point
once resolved at runtime.
</summary><hr/><p>Affected entries are now resolved and rejected/skipped consistently across
admission, the major-upgrade job, and already-persisted Cluster specs.
Contributed by @Anand-240.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11210">#11210</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Updated `google.golang.org/grpc` to v1.83.1, fixing
[CVE-2026-84304](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-84304) /
GHSA-vp52-pcj8-j9qc (gRPC-Go heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame
fragmentation).
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11394">#11394</a></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Changes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>Updated the default PostgreSQL operand image to 18.6-standard-ubi9.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11257">#11257</a></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Bug Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Demoted an unreachable old primary immediately during failover, instead of
waiting on checkpoint and fast-shutdown attempts that could never complete.
</summary><hr/><p>Previously, an old primary whose PostgreSQL had become unresponsive was never
shut down, so it could never rejoin the cluster as a replica of the new
primary. The shutdown is now requested without blocking the reconciler, though
demotion can still take up to a minute or more if PostgreSQL keeps ignoring
shutdown signals.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11347">#11347</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed failover and Pod recreation getting stuck while any instance in the
cluster was fenced.
</summary><hr/><p>A fenced instance kept reporting itself as healthy on its status endpoint even
though its Pod was permanently not Ready, which blocked the readiness guard,
the primary-election logic, and the Pod-reattachment gate from reacting to an
unrelated failure elsewhere in the cluster, leaving it stalled until someone
manually removed the fencing. All three now recognize and skip fenced
instances.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11274">#11274</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a failover that could stall forever or get silently reverted.
</summary><hr/><p>While a failover was pending, the reconciler could skip checking whether it
was ready to complete, or mistake the pending state for a missing Pod and
reset the target primary back to the unhealthy one. It now keeps progressing a
pending failover and completes it once the WAL receivers are down, rechecking
quorum safety right before promoting in case it changed while waiting.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11336">#11336</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed the designated-primary sort in <code>PostgresqlStatusList</code> so a tie on LSN no
longer sorts it out of order.
</summary><hr/><p>If the designated primary's Pod later disappeared from the status list, this
could have led the operator to promote the wrong standby.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11494">#11494</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Stopped abandoning a fast shutdown after 60 seconds.
</summary><hr/><p>The request carried no explicit timeout, so <code>pg_ctl</code> fell back to its own
implicit 60-second limit, and the instance manager, being PID 1 in the
container, took PostgreSQL down mid-shutdown regardless of a larger configured
<code>stopDelay</code>. The fast phase now waits for the full <code>stopDelay</code> instead.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11263">#11263</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Waited for certificate status before refreshing secrets during bootstrap.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11450">#11450</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed in-tree Barman Cloud recovery ignoring `wal.maxParallel` and
`wal.restoreAdditionalCommandArgs`, fetching WAL one segment at a time instead
of using the configured parallelism.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11105">#11105</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Honored the `unrecoverable` annotation on pending and terminating instances.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11241">#11241</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Honored `Backup.spec.online` when finalizing VolumeSnapshot-based backups, so
a cold backup is no longer reported as online in status.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11276">#11276</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Retried volume snapshot backups on transient instance-manager connection
errors (e.g. a dial timeout from a brief pod-network disruption), instead of
failing the backup outright.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11069">#11069</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Set <code>--no-data-checksums</code> explicitly when <code>.spec.postgresql.dataChecksums</code> is
<code>false</code> on PostgreSQL 18+, which now enables checksums by default in <code>initdb</code>.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @evan314159.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11488">#11488</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Stopped discarding <code>.spec.inheritedMetadata</code> labels on PVC reconciliation;
they were applied before, and then overwritten by, the operator's own labels.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @GellertBabel.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11499">#11499</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Stopped <code>Pooler</code> and <code>DatabaseRole</code> from recreating their owned resources
after being marked for deletion, which could block an external finalizer (e.g.
</summary><hr/><p>ArgoCD foreground deletion) waiting for those resources to disappear.
Contributed by @mjlshen.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11359">#11359</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Handled a <code>NULL</code> <code>stats_reset</code> value in the <code>pg_stat_wal</code> metric, which could
occasionally break Prometheus scraping on PostgreSQL 18 clusters.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @HoniSanders.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11207">#11207</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Recovered log streaming when a stale non-FIFO file blocked the log pipe.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11246">#11246</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Stopped sampling logs of the Pods' processes, so no log lines are silently
dropped.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11131">#11131</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Stopped caching Helm release Secrets in the operator, which could spike memory
usage and crashloop the operator on clusters with large Helm releases
installed alongside it.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11211">#11211</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Re-ran owned-resource finalizer cleanup after an operator restart, so a
namespace deleted while the operator was down doesn't hang in `Terminating`
forever.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11215">#11215</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed rejoining replicas taking a long time to complete `pg_rewind` when WAL
prefetching (`wal.maxParallel > 1`) was enabled.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11204">#11204</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Treated a PostgreSQL instance rejecting connections as started up in probes.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11152">#11152</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Stopped issuing a redundant PATCH on every reconciliation when a cluster's
<code>pvcTemplate</code> set <code>volumeAttributesClass</code>.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @andrew-farries.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11196">#11196</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Stopped halting replication slot reconciliation at the first failing slot.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11119">#11119</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>During rollouts, compared the running configuration hash, rather than the
on-disk one, avoiding unnecessary switchovers.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11130">#11130</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Retried `VolumeSnapshot` errors until the deadline, instead of giving up
early.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11132">#11132</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Symlinked `pg_wal` to the WAL volume during plugin-based recovery, instead of
replaying WAL onto the data volume, which could exhaust it on a large
point-in-time recovery.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11127">#11127</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Corrected grammar in <code>PhaseUpgradeDelayed</code> status messages.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @Utkarsh-sharma47.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11065">#11065</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Reported the Postgres capabilities of a plugin correctly.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11447">#11447</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Prevented the plugin status field from flapping on Cluster reconciliation.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @sharifmshaker.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11386">#11386</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>Used UTC time zone for the default backup name.
</td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11329">#11329</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Deleted PVCs before Pods in <code>cnp destroy</code>, avoiding a race that could leave
dangling PVCs needing a second invocation to clean up.
</summary><hr/><p>Contributed by @daanvinken.</p>
</details></td><td><a href="https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/10847">#10847</a></td></tr>
</tbody></table>
